title: Run commands with Infisical secrets
description: Runs the commands in order, stopping at the first failure. Precedence, lowest first: the committed .env files, the Infisical folder, then everything set on purpose — the target's env, .env.local, the shell and a parent target. OFFLINE=1 reads the offline cache instead; CI=true skips Infisical.

path.description: Infisical folder, e.g. /apps/cms. Its sub-folders are included.

commands.description: Commands to run in order through a shell

cwd.description: Working directory relative to the workspace root. Defaults to the project root.

env.description: Values the target sets on purpose; the vault does not overwrite them
